access: Read-only GitHub connector, Library document retrieval, and primary-source web inspection.
scope_limits: The complete repository was not cloned or exhaustively audited.
Incoming ZIP metadata was observed, but archive bytes were not downloaded or compared with the reviewed Library copies.
Historical native test and benchmark claims are source observations, not results rerun by this contribution.
No production source was changed; no native recognizer integration or whole-knot benchmark was run.
The reference implementation and new proofs do not establish a source-complete bounded-width geometric producer or general quasi-polynomial unknot recognition.
No third-party source paper, archive, font file, or private personal data is included.
